dispositions.topic_text: Provider module and concrete type or representation for WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS
dispositions.what: The type of the imported WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS constant in the data provider closure (an immutable set or sequence of integer code points, or of one-code-point strings) and its membership test; every option keeps A02 rule 1: exactly the 25 listed code points are white space, and strip(v) removes them from both ends. State 6's data provider closure does not hold it yet.
keeps:
White space, here and wherever this specification reads a given value's
   white space, is exactly the 25 code points of Unicode's `White_Space`
   property: U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to
   U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F and U+3000; no other character is
   white space, whatever a language's own operation counts, and `strip(v)`
   below removes these from both ends of `v`.
options: Export an immutable set of integer Unicode code points from `data_provider`.
Export an immutable sequence of integer Unicode code points from `data_provider`.
Export an immutable collection of one-code-point strings or a closed range table from `data_provider`.
consequences: The choice fixes the generated constant type and membership expression, but every option must represent exactly the specified set and produce identical required, optional and padded-text outcomes.

dispositions.topic_text: Definition of what counts as another place holding the white-space set
dispositions.reason: 'No other place holds it' is the case's standing form for a release constant (A18 rule 4's BACKUP_RETENTION_HOURS, A02 rule 4's ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS): no other production definition of the value exists and every reader imports it. A test spelling the expected set out independently is evidence about the value, not a home of it, as the tests of the other constants already do.

dispositions.topic_text: Required tests for the exact 25-code-point white-space behavior and exclusions
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show A02 rule 1's white space set — every listed code point and characters outside it (U+200B, U+001C to U+001F) — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
White space, here and wherever this specification reads a given value's
   white space, is exactly the 25 code points of Unicode's `White_Space`
   property: U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to
   U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F and U+3000; no other character is
   white space, whatever a language's own operation counts, and `strip(v)`
   below removes these from both ends of `v`.
options: Require an exact assertion that `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` contains precisely the listed code points plus behavioral tests for required, optional and padded values.
Exercise every listed member and representative excluded characters behaviorally.
Retain only the existing ASCII-space examples.
consequences: Without exact included-and-excluded coverage, generated code can pass every stated Required test while violating A02's closed-set guarantee.
